## Technical analysis

### Day 5 of BUY Signal — The $75K Test: Support Confirmed, Lower Highs Continue

Aug 23 is the second flat session of the current BUY signal (+0.10%), but conceals the most dramatic intraday structure of the five-day signal: BTC round-tripped from the opening $77,311 to the session low $75,550 (a $1,761 drop) to the session high $77,772 (a $2,221 recovery from the low) before settling at $77,395. The session's defining development is the confirmation of $75,000 as a real structural support level — not just a number on a chart.

At the same time, three consecutive declining session highs ($79,518 → $78,826 → $77,772) represent the week's primary technical warning: sellers are defending at progressively lower levels.

### Session Map (Crypto.com 1H Candles — Aug 22 20:00 UTC → Aug 23 20:00 UTC)

| 23:00 UTC | $77,001 | $77,131 | $76,895 | $77,074 | 53.9 BTC |

The 21:00 UTC candle is the session's opening statement from bears: open at the reference level ($77,312) and dropped immediately to $76,815, a $497 bearish candle. Recovery in the 22:00-23:00 UTC window to $77,074 shows buyers are present but sellers have momentum.

**Phase 2 — Overnight Drift Lower (Aug 23 00:00-04:00 UTC)**

| 03:00 UTC | $77,079 | $77,147 | $76,838 | $76,929 | 57.9 BTC |
| 04:00 UTC | $76,929 | $77,040 | **$76,458** | $76,603 | **145.1 BTC** |

A gradual drift from $77,308 (00:00 UTC) to $76,603 (04:00 UTC close). The 04:00 UTC candle is the pre-capitulation setup: volume picks up to 145 BTC (the session's third-largest to this point), and the low of $76,458 is the tightest point above the capitulation zone. The 04:00 UTC low of $76,458 is essentially the Aug 22 session low ($76,452) — the same demand zone from yesterday. The setup: if buyers don't hold $76,458, the next support is $75,000.

**Phase 3 — The 05:00 UTC Capitulation Candle**

| Candle | Open | High | Low | Close | Volume |
|--------|------|------|-----|-------|--------|
| 05:00 UTC | $76,595 | $76,740 | **$75,550** | $76,055 | **309.96 BTC ($23.6M)** |

The session's pivotal candle. Open at $76,595, briefly pushed to $76,740, then sellers (and forced liquidations — $28.9M reported) drove price to the session low of $75,550.89. The low is $449 above $75,000 — the closest BTC has come to the gamma absorption zone since the Aug 21 squeeze.

Candle structure: it is a bearish candle (close $76,055 < open $76,595) with a very long lower wick ($76,740 high to $75,550 low = $1,190 range). The recovery from $75,550 to $76,055 within the same hour shows that buyers absorbed the liquidation event immediately — the demand is real and positioned at this specific level.

For scale: this 310-BTC candle is 2.9x the next-largest candle of the session (14:00 UTC at 203.6 BTC). On a session with 2,328 BTC total, this one candle is 13.3% of session volume. A single candle containing 1/8 of the day's trading volume, and every seller was absorbed.

**Phase 4 — Post-Capitulation Stabilization (06:00-10:00 UTC)**

No further breakdown below $75,879 after the $75,550 session low — the capitulation is complete and buyers have stabilized. The 08:00 UTC candle (108.3 BTC, $8.3M): open $76,008, close $76,482 (+$474) — a constructive bounce that confirms EU session buyers stepping in at $76K. This is NOT a gamma squeeze (108 BTC vs 649 BTC on Aug 21), but the direction is positive and the close is a 2.6x expansion vs. the 07:00 UTC range.

**Phase 5 — US Session Rally (11:00-14:00 UTC)**

The bull sequence. The 11:00 UTC candle reclaims $77,000 on 94.6 BTC — a single-candle $524 gain. The 13:00 UTC candle prints the session high of $77,772.38 on 150 BTC ($11.6M). Then the 14:00 UTC candle — the US session's most active at 203.6 BTC ($15.7M) — reverses from the $77,645 high back to $77,182 close. Sellers re-emerged at $77,645-$77,772, just as they did at $78.5K yesterday and $79.5K the day before.

**Phase 6 — Afternoon Consolidation (15:00-20:00 UTC)**

Post-reference-close: BTC climbed to **$77,714.54** by 21:45 UTC (Crypto.com live ticker) — a positive signal for Monday's EU open.

### Trend Read — Five Sessions

| Session | Ref Close | Change | Session High | Session Low | Volume |
|---------|-----------|--------|-------------|-------------|--------|
| Aug 19 (Day 1) | $69,045 | — | — | — | ~2,758 BTC |
| Aug 20 (Day 2) | $73,530 | +6.50% | ~$73,083 | — | ~3,825 BTC |
| Aug 21 (Day 3) | $77,504 | +5.40% | $79,518 | ~$73,000 | ~10,077 BTC |
| Aug 22 (Day 4) | $77,318 | −0.24% | $78,826 | $76,452 | ~6,591 BTC |
| Aug 23 (Day 5) | $77,395 | +0.10% | **$77,772** | **$75,550** | ~2,328 BTC |

The trend is: strong up (Days 1-3), then sideways (Days 4-5). The sideways phase is occurring at -2.7% from the Day 3 peak ($79,518), which is healthy consolidation. BTC is above its estimated 50-DMA (~$70,000-$72,000, incorporating the pre-rally $64K-$69K range over the prior 50 sessions) and well above its estimated 200-DMA (~$65,000-$68,000). The near-term trend is constructive; the concern is the three-consecutive-lower-high pattern.

### Momentum

After a 22% weekly gain, RSI is elevated. The two flat sessions (Days 4 and 5) at -0.24% and +0.10% have allowed RSI to cool from overbought territory — this is constructive. However, the lower-high pattern is a momentum divergence: price is essentially flat while session highs are declining ($79,518 → $77,772), meaning each bull attempt is being capped at a lower level. Momentum is still positive (above estimated 50-DMA by ~7-10%) but decelerating.

### Volume Analysis — Distribution Pattern

| Session | Volume | vs. Prior |
|---------|--------|-----------|
| Aug 19 | ~2,758 BTC | baseline |
| Aug 20 | ~3,825 BTC | +39% |
| Aug 21 | ~10,077 BTC | +163% |
| Aug 22 | ~6,591 BTC | −35% |
| Aug 23 | **~2,328 BTC** | **−65%** |

The five-session volume profile follows a classic gamma-squeeze distribution: Volume builds (Days 1-3), peaks at the squeeze event (Day 3), then contracts (Days 4-5). Weekend volume contraction accounts for ~20-30% of the decline structurally. The remaining ~35-45% reflects genuine demand moderation as the momentum buyers who drove the 22% weekly gain step aside.

Critical observation: In every session where volume was constructive (Days 1-3), the session's largest candles were advancing. In the past two sessions (Days 4-5), the session's largest candles have been reversals: Aug 22's 842-BTC seller at $78.5K, Aug 23's 310-BTC capitulation to $75.5K. Volume structure has shifted from confirming to questioning the trend.

### ★ Strongest Support — $75,000 (Now CONFIRMED by Aug 23 Test)

The $75,000 gamma support zone was directly tested today and held:
- **Aug 21 (establishing event)**: 649.8 BTC ($51.5M) absorbed in one hour during the 08:00 UTC gamma squeeze
- **Aug 23 (first test)**: Session low $75,550.89 — 309.96 BTC capitulation candle; buyers absorbed all selling; same-candle recovery to $76,054; US session subsequently rallied to $77,772

Evidence for the ★ support:
1. **Gamma absorption**: The Aug 21 squeeze forced call sellers to buy BTC at $75K; their long positions create real demand on pullbacks
2. **Test-and-hold**: $75,550 was the lowest tick of the session; zero candle closed below $75,879 after the low; the demand zone absorbed the full selling force
3. **Recovery magnitude**: From $75,550 session low to $77,772 session high is +$2,221 (+2.9%) — the full session rally originated from the $75K zone
4. **Resistance-becomes-support sequence**: Aug 19: $65,500 absorbed → Aug 20: $70,000 absorbed → Aug 21: $75,000 absorbed → Aug 23: $75,000 CONFIRMED; the pattern is intact

The $75,000 level is the **critical decision point**: a close below $75,000 would break the sequence and signal the support zone failed. As long as BTC closes above $75,000, the bullish framework is structurally intact.

### ★ Strongest Resistance — $79,000-$79,518 (Double-Tested, Sellers Holding)

Unchanged from Aug 22 analysis — the $79K zone has been tested twice:
1. **Aug 21 (08:00 UTC gamma squeeze)**: BTC reached $79,518.33, reversed to $77,241 in one hour (724.4 BTC)
2. **Aug 22 (05:00 UTC reversal)**: BTC approached from $78,578, sellers drove to $76,452 (842.1 BTC)

Evidence:
1. **Two failed approaches**: Two sessions, two approaches, two $2,000+ intraday reversals — all from the same $78.5K-$79.5K zone
2. **Above-average volume on both reversals**: 842 BTC (Aug 22) and 724 BTC (Aug 21) are above the average session candle — real institutional selling, not thin-market noise
3. **Call-OI concentration**: Call sellers who were forced from $70K-$75K strikes have repositioned at $79K-$80K; their delta-hedging creates automatic supply at these levels
4. **Analyst consensus**: Technical analysis searches confirm resistance consensus at $78,036-$80,000 (CoinMarketCap analysis)

Note: The declining session highs ($79,518 → $78,826 → $77,772) mean the $79K zone is being approached from progressively lower levels — buyers are getting weaker with each attempt, not stronger. The $79K resistance will require a step-change in volume (>500 BTC/h at EU open) to overcome.

### New Near-Term Resistance: $77,645-$77,772

Today's session created a new intermediate resistance zone: the 13:00 UTC candle hit $77,772 and the 14:00 UTC candle hit $77,645 on the day's second-heaviest volume (203.6 BTC). Sellers emerged at both prints. This zone ($77,645-$77,772) is now the first resistance for Monday's session — a lower barrier than $78,826, but one that must be cleared to maintain the upside momentum narrative.

### What Would Change the Read

**Extend BUY HIGH / Raise Conviction:** Monday close above $77,772 on >200 BTC/h (breaks the three-session lower-high pattern); Aug 24 ETF flows positive (Condition 2 Day 6 confirmed); NVDA Aug 26 beat with strong AI guidance.

**Shift to MEDIUM Conviction (still BUY):** Monday session high capped at or below $77,772 (four consecutive lower highs); volume fails to recover above 3,000 BTC; Aug 24 ETF flows positive but decelerating further from $307M.

**Step-Aside (maintain step-aside until criteria re-met):** Reference close below $65,000 (Condition 1 breach) OR most recent daily ETF flows negative (Condition 2 breach).

**Emergency Step-Aside Watch (close below $75,000):** A Monday close below $75,000 would break the gamma-support structure and require immediate framework re-evaluation; while Condition 1 would technically remain met ($65K floor), the structural thesis underlying HIGH conviction would weaken significantly.
